primary_gt.final_classification: all five Ian landfall threshold windows pass

ledger_rows.reason: Peak gust and minimum pressure are simultaneous, and the 24-hour pressure fall is 42.5 hPa.
Event rainfall exceeds 200 mm and the wettest 24 hours contain 70.9 percent of the total.
The wettest hour is 3 hours after the pressure minimum while gust and pressure extrema are simultaneous.
The Red catalog entry and 0.742 local gust ratio pass the wind consistency thresholds.
The daily point total, peak daily rain, and all three gridded maximum-to-mean ratios pass their thresholds.

criteria.name: Required JSON ledger
criteria.description: Returns target_family, exactly five named ledger_rows, formula_or_test, values, pass, reason, final_classification, and numeric_summary.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one missing row or minor schema omissions; award 1 point for prose with recognizable row labels.

criteria.name: Wind-pressure calculation
criteria.description: Computes peak gust, peak sustained wind, gust-to-wind ratio, pressure minimum, pressure falls, and wind-threshold hour counts accurately.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly correct wind and pressure values with one missing derived value; award 1 point for copied peaks only.

criteria.name: Rainfall and timing calculation
criteria.description: Computes event rainfall over the locked event window, wettest 6-hour/24-hour/48-hour windows, event shares, and pressure-linked timing lags accurately.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct totals with one wrong rolling window or lag; award 1 point for qualitative rainfall statements without calculations.

criteria.name: Threshold decisions
criteria.description: Applies the 40 hPa, 200 mm, 0.65 share, 6-hour lag, 0.70 gust-ratio, 30000 kmh2, 150 mm, 50 mm, and grid-ratio thresholds correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct pass/fail calls with one or two threshold mistakes.

criteria.name: Catalog and precipitation cross-checks
criteria.description: Uses catalog wind and precipitation-product values as numeric checks, including grid ratios computed from source max/mean values before display rounding, without replacing station wind or mixing daily and hourly totals.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for including these checks but omitting one required ratio or day.

criteria.name: Final result
criteria.description: Gives answer all_five_tests_pass and classification all five Ian landfall threshold windows pass.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for an equivalent final result with incomplete wording.

criteria.name: Concise computed output
criteria.description: Keeps the answer calculation-led and avoids casualty totals, damage totals, or other claims not computed in the ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for one minor extra claim that does not alter the numeric result.
